messages:
marta: FYI team — quick coordinated maintenance tonight 00:30 UTC (short window). We're applying a micro-kernel patch + model pin to redwood-v2-stable-2026 and a small batching tweak. Customer-facing window ~00:30-00:55 UTC.

deploybot: Job queued: runtime-eu-midnight-2026-06-10. Canary: 5% on eu-dedicated-03. Plan: canary -> 15% -> 40% -> 100%. Auto-rollback: 2m sustained 5xx > 0.9% OR p99 >= baseline*1.5 OR decode corruption samples >0.02%.

rick: Can we prepare two status variants: (A) short public blurb, (B) longer internal note for support triage? I'll schedule the public one 20m prior.

marta: Public blurb draft: "Planned maintenance (EU): brief runtime update and temporary model pin on 2026-06-10 00:30 UTC. Most customers will be unaffected; some requests may see short retries during canary. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2905550000"

tani: Internal support blurb draft (copy):

tani: ```Internal: Rollout will use canary -> staged tranches. Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >0.9% (2m) or p99 >= baseline*1.5 (3m) or evidence of output corruption. If triggered: pause rollout, re-pin to redwood-v2-stable-prev, notify customers and open incident channel. Contact SRE if affected traffic >5%.```

ops_sre: Preflight checklist: 1) curl /health on canary -> 200 2) run long-prompt smoke suite 3) snapshot KV caches 4) verify fallback model redwood-v2-stable-fallback available 5) confirm SLO dashboards open. We'll abort if any preflight fails.

emily: Customer email copy (short): Subject: Planned maintenance  EU runtime (Jun 10 00:30 UTC)
emily: Body: "We will perform a brief runtime update in EU on Jun 10 at 00:30 UTC. Most requests will be unaffected; a small number may experience transient retries during canary. The model redwood-v2-stable-2026 will be pinned during the change. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/"

account_manager: Add note for enterprise customers: "If you have Dedicated pools and did not receive outreach from your account team, you will not be affected."

rick: Also prepare SMS for on-call customers (opt-in only): short link + time.

support-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish status 2026-06-09T00:10:00Z (20m prior).

marta: Thumbs up to schedule? @rick @ops_sre @tani

ops_sre: :thumbsup:

rick: :thumbsup:

tani: :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started. Canary pulse (4m): 5xx 0.04%, p99 +9%. No rollback conditions met. Proceeding to 15% in 5m.

ops_sre: Noting one canary host intermittent fd spike; excluding host from next tranche. No customer-visible errors.

marta: Excluded host and continue. We'll extend 15% hold to 12m to watch p99.

deploybot: 15% complete. Holding. Metrics: 5xx 0.06%, p99 +12%.

rick: Support FAQ snippet: "Why pin my model?" -> "We pin to maintain deterministic outputs while kernel and batching changes are applied. Pin removed after verification window."

emily: Statuspage published and email queued to low-priority list. SMS queued for HA contacts.

support-bot: Statuspage posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2905550000  scheduled publish 2026-06-09T00:10:00Z

ops_sre: 40% tranche started. Monitoring error and latency streams.

deploybot: 40% complete. Metrics stable: 5xx 0.07%, p99 +10%. No rollback.

tani: Small sample of decode anomalies reported by synthetic test harness (2 requests). Pattern looks like prompt edge-case not widespread; flagging model team to review post-rollout.

marta: Continue rollout but collect offending request IDs. If errors scale to thresholds, we rollback.

deploybot: 100% rollout complete at 00:49 UTC. No rollback triggered.

emily: Final status update posted: maintenance complete, no widespread customer impact. We'll follow up with a brief note if the model team asks to unpin.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2905550000  resolved 2026-06-10T00:55:00Z

marta: Post-action: please file a 1-paragraph RCA only if customers report anomalies. Otherwise archive incident stub in ops repo.
